    • createRecipe

      @Transactional public ChefPreviewRecipeDTO createRecipe(CreateRecipeDTO recipeDTO)
      function called by the chef to write a new recipe: the recipe is on a waiting list at the beginning and it will wait for admin's approval.
      Parameters:
      recipeDTO - DTO with all the obbligatory fields inserted by the chef when he writes the recipe
      Returns:
      DTO with a recipe preview to show the chef while he wait for the approval
      Throws:
      NoSuchElementException - if the chef is not found, if the admin is not found and if one of the fields is wrong/missing
